4883647.note: Carnell Tate (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bengals, leaving Ayomanor and Wan'Dale Robinson as the top wide receivers in the passing game, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

4890973.name: Ashton Jeanty
4890973.note: Jeanty rushed eight times for 15 yards and brought in all eight targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

4911851.name: LeQuint Allen Jr.
4911851.note: Allen (hamstring) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Colts.

4912218.name: Cyrus Allen
4912218.note: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Wednesday that Allen will "get a little bit more [snaps]" during Sunday's game against the Broncos, Nate Taylor of ESPN.com reports.

5081397.name: Dylan Sampson
5081397.note: Sampson (knee) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

5081432.name: Antonio Williams
5081432.note: Coach Dan Quinn noted Monday that with Terry McLaurin (knee) out for the season, Stefon Diggs' workload isn't expected to change much, however others, notably Williams, should see added opportunities in McLaurin's looming absence, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

5081999.name: CJ Donaldson
5081999.note: Donaldson (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Steelers in Paris.

5083076.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
5083076.note: Fannin caught six of nine targets for 91 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Titans.

5083315.name: Kenyon Sadiq
5083315.note: Sadiq caught his lone target for six yards in Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.

5083754.name: Ryan Flournoy
5083754.note: Flournoy secured all four targets for 70 yards in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night.

5092508.name: Colbie Young
5092508.note: Young (knee) was not listed on the Bengals' injury report Wednesday.

5093923.name: Andrew Armstrong
5093923.note: Armstrong caught one of two targets for three yards during Sunday night's 20-3 loss to Seattle.

5123663.name: Isaac TeSlaa
5123663.note: TeSlaa caught one of his two targets for 10 yards in the Lions' 20-17 win over the Packers on Sunday.

5155825.name: Carter Runyon
5155825.note: Runyon (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

5220680.name: Ted Hurst III
5220680.note: Hurst didn't record a catch on one target in Sunday's 43-13 win over the Panthers.

8439.name: Aaron Rodgers
8439.note: Rodgers completed 19 of 30 passes for 212 passes and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints. He added six yards on three carries.
